title: Add an unmapped SKU to an offer
summary: The picker behind Add to an offer for Google Play's holiday_bundle, which sold 3 times with no offer: a new offer from the SKU (name and the add-on it sells) or an existing offer as its second Google Play SKU, and one change that maps the SKU, re-verifies the 3 purchases and updates those players' licenses.
compare: Opened from the danger callout on Offers, the attention row on Storefronts, or 'Add the SKU to an offer' in Purchases; all three open this one dialog.
Two choices: a new offer from the SKU (selected by default, with Name and the add-on it sells, one-time as the store sells it) or an existing offer as a second SKU for the same store.

The 'In the same change' box names what else happens: the purchases are re-verified with the store and the add-on lands on those players' licenses, named, with the usual purchase email. There is no separate re-verify step anywhere.
The button says the outcome and the count: 'Create offer and update 3 licenses' (or 'Add to Dice skins and update 3 licenses' for the second choice).
On success a toast says '3 players now have Holiday bundle'; the callout, the attention row and the 'Added nothing' tab count all clear.
An undeclared add-on can't be chosen; Licensing is linked for defining one.
Phone: a bottom sheet; the two fields stack; buttons full width with the primary on top.

findings.issue: The subtitle adds nothing and the name list does not scale.
findings.resolution: 'Pick what it sells.' cut; names capped at two plus '1 more'.
